headline: Sheikha Hoor Al Qasimi becomes the first Arab curator of Venice Biennale
label: NEWS
caption:
A historic moment for the region as a leading arts figure takes the global stage 🎨

Sheikha Hoor Al Qasimi has been appointed as the curator of the 2028 Venice Biennale, according to reports from The National and Arab News.

She makes history as the first Arab curator to take on the prestigious role for the international art exhibition.

Her appointment highlights the growing global recognition of artists and cultural leaders from the Middle East.
